videos.video_subject: In March 2024 Jude Bellingham headed in what looked like a stoppage-time winner at Valencia, but referee Gil Manzano had already blown for full time; Bellingham's protest earned him a red card and a suspension from the Spanish federation
videos.video_script: Bellingham headed in the winner at Valencia. The referee had already blown for full time. Jude said one word to him. Red card, a two match ban, and a fine.
